answer.prompt:
Edit image 1: a long, empty living room viewed toward a black-framed balcony door. Images 2–13 are each one product to add. Reproduce every product exactly as in its photo, with the same shape, proportions, colors, materials and details. Do not use similar substitutes.

Left wall, middle of the room: place sofa 4 side-on, facing the right wall, about 2.2 m long. Lay rug 9 (133×195 cm) on the floor in front of and under the sofa, with stripes running lengthwise. Set coffee table 6 on the rug in front of the sofa. Put two red cushions 12 on the sofa. Stand black floor lamp 8 in the gap between the sofa's balcony-side end and the wall, taller than the sofa. Hang prints 11 as a grid above the sofa.

Right wall: place TV bench 5 (120 cm, knee-high) facing the sofa. Closer to the balcony, place desk 2 (105×50 cm) against the wall, with chair 3 at it facing the wall. Mount shelf 7 (79 cm) above the desk.

Hang teal curtains 10 on a rod above the balcony door, drawn open. Put plant 13 in its terracotta pot on the floor left of the door.

Keep everything else unchanged: framing, camera, walls, ceiling, floor and light. Add realistic shadows and daylight from the balcony. Output a real photograph, not a render.

placements.where: on rug in front of sofa
floor under sofa and coffee table
